tagline: Your medical history, connected when it matters.
heroDescription: ANVAY connects patients, doctors and healthcare institutions through a secure digital healthcare network so critical medical information can be available to authorized professionals when needed.

demoHealthProfile.name: Rahul Sharma
demoHealthProfile.warning: Critical information is available only to authorized healthcare professionals.

problemSection.heading: Closing the healthcare information gap
problemSection.description: Patient medical information is often scattered across hospitals, documents and independent healthcare systems.
problemSection.problem01Text: During emergencies, patients may be unconscious or unable to communicate their allergies, medical conditions, medications or previous treatment history.
problemSection.approach02Text: ANVAY securely links verified identity with important medical information and allows controlled healthcare access through authorized accounts across all participating hospitals.

featuresSection.heading: One connected healthcare ecosystem
featuresSection.description: Designed to connect patients, healthcare professionals and institutions.
featuresSection.card1Desc: Every registered account receives a unique ANVAY ID automatically for longitudinal health tracking.
featuresSection.card2Desc: Store important information including conditions, allergies, medicines and complete medical history.
featuresSection.card3Desc: Verified doctors can securely access patient information according to their credentials and authorization.
featuresSection.card4Desc: Healthcare institutions can securely participate in the connected ANVAY network with provenance integrity.
featuresSection.card5Desc: Important medical information can be available through controlled break-glass emergency access.
featuresSection.card6Desc: Record access is permanently logged with user, institution, timestamp and clinical purpose.

workflowSection.heading: How ANVAY works
workflowSection.step1Desc: Create a Patient or Hospital account.
workflowSection.step2Desc: A unique ANVAY ID is automatically generated.
workflowSection.step3Desc: Relevant medical information becomes part of the healthcare profile.
workflowSection.step4Desc: Authorized healthcare professionals access relevant information.

securitySection.heading: Healthcare connectivity with privacy at its core.
securitySection.description: ANVAY is designed around verified identity, secure authentication, controlled permissions and traceable medical record access.

joinSection.heading: Join the ANVAY healthcare network
joinSection.subheading: Create your healthcare account and receive your unique ANVAY ID.
